data.title: Rooftops and the museum gable
data.caption: Rīga Old Town rooftops in yellow, orange and red tile, with a dark cathedral tower rising behind a gable marked MUSEUM.

data.title: Cathedral tower
data.caption: The cathedral tower with its two clocks, seen from a side street. The sky was replaced in editing.

data.title: Brass band
data.caption: A military brass band marching over the cobblestones, tuba and cymbals at the front.

data.title: Through the Swedish Gate
data.caption: Looking through an old stone gate down a cobbled street hung with bunting and Latvian flags, with one walker in the middle.
